QUOTE: "$ENTROPIC_LIB → $ENTROPIC_HOME → ~/.entropic → ldconfig" and "`find()` checks several install layouts, then falls back to `ctypes.util.find_library`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the resolution order (env overrides, then ~/.entropic, then ldconfig). It only says "several install layouts" and never says two directory layouts are tried per root.
